create_LlavaOnevisionProcessor: create a LlavaOnevisionProcessor instance with image_processor, tokenizer, and optional video_processor for multimodal input
call_processor_images_text: call the LlavaOnevisionProcessor with images and text inputs to produce tokenized BatchFeature with input_ids and pixel_values
call_processor_videos_text: call the LlavaOnevisionProcessor with videos and text inputs to produce tokenized BatchFeature with input_ids and pixel_values_videos
expand_image_tokens: expand image tokens in text prompts by replacing <image> placeholders with the correct number of tokens based on image resolution
get_number_of_features: get the number of vision features for an image given its original height and width against a processed resolution
